capabilities: Browse the vault repository's full commit history via git log
Read per-commit diffs with file collapsing, line numbers, and rename detection
Tick per-file review circles and approve commits individually or in bulk up to a date
Filter commits by review state and search by message, hash, or author
Keep approval state out of git history by auto-managing .gitignore for the plugin's data.json
extras: Desktop only; requires a git repository at the vault root. Review-state sync via Obsidian Sync is whole-file, last-writer-wins and is only read at startup, so the README warns to review on one device at a time and reload before switching.
motivation: Built for the classic Obsidian Git auto-commit setup, where commits pile up faster than you can read them.
problem: Auto-commit setups like Obsidian Git pile up commits faster than anyone can read them, and there is no way to track which commits have already been reviewed.

relations.evidence: Built for the classic Obsidian Git auto-commit setup
you can opt in to syncing it with Obsidian Sync

summary: Git history review tool that walks through vault commits with a dark-mode diff view and tracks which commits and files you have reviewed and approved.
